title: Spider Silk
subtitle: They depict everything without saying a word.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why do you want to go to Stefen's room exactly? Is it related to our investigation?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Of course, boss.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: I'm here looking for Kayla, just as you're looking for that sheep-headed ...
She falls into an unusual silence.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What is it?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: That arcanist you're looking for, is her name Barbara?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You know her?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Yup, we met.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: On Route 77.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: I'd just got done asking two men about Kayla's whereabouts, and saw that it was getting dark.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: My sight ain't so good at night. And the nights are long these days.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: So I was in a bit of a hurry, hoping to get somewhere with proper lights as fast as I could.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: That's when I saw her, Barbara—all alone by the road. Some jerk of a driver dumped her there, and she asked me for a ride.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: I turned her down. Heck, I could hardly see. She'd have been better off waiting for the next driver than riding with a blind bat like me, you know?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: But as I drove away, I changed my mind. She was too young to be left out there all by herself.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: So I turned back to get her. But when I arrived, she was already gone. There was nothing but a trail of hoofprints in the dirt.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: When I got to the motel, I saw those hoofprints again. I gotta say, I was kinda relieved to see them. At least she made it here safely.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And is she still here?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Well, I've never seen any hoofprints leaving the motel.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: But that don't mean she's still here. You gotta be mindful of what your mind picks up and what might slip you by. It's easy to ignore other evidence when what you've seen already fits your hypothesis.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: That being said, it's still likely that she's somewhere in the motel.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Alright. Then let's look for her.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: It seems we're in agreement. To room 214.
She counts the doors as they walk down the hallway.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Mm?
Out of the corner of her eye, a flash of red catches her attention.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: I've checked those two. Ain't much in them.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Argus, did you see a red door just now?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: A red door?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Nothing. Must've been my imagination.
As they approach the end of the hallway, they spot room 214. The door is slightly ajar—clearly Stefen left in a hurry.
Room 214, Tuesday's Motel
They enter. The thick curtains are pulled shut, blocking out almost all the light from outside. They're hit with the stale, sour smell of old alcohol.
The glow in Argus's eye flickers like a light with a faulty circuit.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you alright? Can you still see?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Don't worry about it. Ain't the first time this has happened.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: This eye issue runs in the family. It's the price we pay for having our arcane power.
The mercenary glances around the room, a slight frown on her face.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Now, what are we looking for, boss?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: People leave all kinds of evidence behind all the time. It'll be like wandering around in the woods without a compass if we don't know what we're looking for.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: So, if you don't wanna be inundated with meaningless clues, you need to give me some directions.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Alright. First, I'd like to know what happened to Barbara.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Second ...
Fleeting images surface in her mind.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Whether Manus Vindictae has been here, or anyone from that Order of Enlightenment. And last ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: About Mr. Stefen. The pistol he used was a Zeno military weapon, and he seemed to know about my relation to the vacuum bomb operation. It's likely that he once held a high rank within the Zeno military.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I want to know why he came to this motel and what happened to make him lose his mind here.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: "Lose his mind here"? What makes you think he wasn't crazy already?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Zeno pays much more attention to its soldiers' mental well-being than any conventional military organization.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's because quite a few of them are arcanists. They're both Zeno's strength and weakness.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So I'm inclined to think Mr. Stefen developed these mental health issues after entering the motel.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Huh, is that so? I gotta say, I don't know much about all this military institution stuff.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Right, so here's the plan: first, locate Barbara; second, look for any signs of Manus Vindictae or the Order of Enlightenment; and third, find out how poor old Stefen lost his marbles.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: And, of course, I've got my own business to deal with—tracking down Kayla.
She starts to meticulously search the room.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Hey, boss! I've got something.
There's a series of small but clear traces imprinted in the dust.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: These footprints are from a spider. Looks like the little guy went back and forth along here quite a few times. I know this might not seem pertinent to our investigation, but it is worth noting. You ever seen a spider make a phone call?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm afraid I'm not interested in the movements of spiders right now.
Argus shrugs.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Come on, boss, loosen up a little.
*drip-drip*
The sound of dripping water echoes nearby.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Do you hear that? Sounds like dripping water.
*drip-drip-drip*
With every drip, a water stain grows larger and larger on the wallpaper.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: I'm sure it's just the motel plumbing.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But ...
The stain gradually takes the form of a hand, its five fingers all clearly defined.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Watch out!
Suddenly, the hand pulls itself from the wall and slams down.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This place is definitely more than meets the eye.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: I'm with you on that.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: There's just too much arcanum-related weirdness going on here. Never seen so many arrays in a motel before.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But we've only found one.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: In your room, yeah.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: But there are a load more. One room has them drawn from floor to ceiling.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Looked like some kinda transformation array to me. I ain't no expert, so, I can't say for sure.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What are they trying to do, I wonder?

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Who knows.
She brings the conversation to an abrupt end and continues searching the room.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Oh, boss, you might be interested in this.
She peers under the bed.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: It's another one. Just like the others.
A huge array lies beneath the bed. It's scattered with dark crystals.
The design is familiar.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I've seen this before. It was also drawn in that parchment notebook.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is indeed a transformation array. But it's not in its full form.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: They were trying something. Check it out.
She plucks a hair from the carpet.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: This is hair from the mane of a howler lion, and there are some other materials around it, too. Not exactly sure what they are, though. They're too finely ground.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: But one thing's for sure: Someone held a ceremony here, and for some reason, it didn't work out for them.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is important. The Foundation needs to know about this.
The air is silent.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Argus?
The mercenary doesn't respond. She's still staring at the strand of hair between her fingers. It's chestnut colored.

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: This is Kayla's hair. She was here! In this room!

items.speaker: Argus
items.text: Or at least someone who came into contact with her.
The phone rings, cutting her off.
